scope: Twenty-eight complete proof sections and 12 full source appendices. Original theta norms, quartet derivative costs, both Stieltjes branches, arithmetic Gram determinants, spectral-sum relative fibres, the full differential connection and conormal finite Weyl and residue maps.

Third-party literature PDFs remain local reading copies; public source URLs and exact retrieval hashes are included.
